problem: Canonical MKB problem intelligence existed in the portal executive problem cards, but context was not systematically projected into the other Powerhouse surfaces where impact, decisions, monitoring and evidence are interpreted.
root_cause: The canonical intake contract defined routing to customer intelligence but did not define contextual visual projection surfaces or a reusable visual context schema.
fix: Extend problem projection with symptoms, trigger, segment, source/freshness, benchmark context and five priority dimensions
Render visual signal meters and context chips on executive problem cards
Embed the same PH-Pxxx context into Impact, Next Best Actions, Monitoring & Learning and Evidence Health
Keep external signals as context until tenant evidence supports relevance
Codify contextual visual projection in the canonical intake contract and skill
prevention_rule: Future Problem Radar portal work must reuse the same PH-Pxxx/evidence lineage and project it only where decision context is materially useful; never create a separate dashboard or parallel problem truth.

invariants: same PH-Pxxx truth across portal surfaces
external evidence never becomes tenant fact by display alone
visual priority dimensions are evidence context, not fabricated market statistics
